data.charging_refresh_interval: Ask the car for data every N minutes while charging
data.track_location: Show the car on the map (device tracker)
data.idle_refresh_interval: Check on the parked car every N hours/days

data_description.charging_refresh_interval: Sends the "Refresh data" command only while the car's last known state is charging. Off by default.
data_description.data_fresh_minutes: Used by the "Data Fresh" binary sensor.
data_description.use_websocket: The server pushes changes as they happen. The update interval then acts only as a slow safety poll (1 hour or the interval, whichever is longer). Turn off if your network blocks WebSockets.
data_description.track_location: On: a device tracker entity shows the car on the map. Off: no tracker is created and the position is left out of the Status sensor attributes.
data_description.idle_refresh_interval: Sends "Refresh data" to the car when it has been silent this long and is neither charging nor driving. Each command wakes the car's modem (12 V battery), so use a long interval; after a timeout it waits a full interval before trying again. Off by default.
